name: NBA projection shadow refresh
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 10 * * *'
permissions: { contents: read }
concurrency:
  group: nba-factual-observation-refresh
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      NBA_PROJECTION_INGEST_BASE_URL: https://www.111sports.app
      NBA_PROJECTION_INGEST_SECRET: ${{ secrets.NBA_PROJECTION_INGEST_SECRET }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '22' }
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --omit=optional
      - run: node scripts/run-nba-projection-shadow-refresh.cjs

name: NFL projection shadow generation
on:
  # Manual-only until Phase C's cache migration is reviewed/applied and first-run audit is approved.
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: { contents: read }
jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      NFL_PROJECTION_INGEST_BASE_URL: https://www.111sports.app
      NFL_PROJECTION_INGEST_SECRET: ${{ secrets.NFL_PROJECTION_INGEST_SECRET }}
      NFL_PROJECTION_SEASON: '2026'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '22' }
      - run: node scripts/run-nfl-projection-generation.cjs
